name: Fast Green FCF
aliases: INS 143, fast green FCF, fast green, FD&C Green No. 3, FD&C Green 3, Green 3, Food Green 3
what_is: A synthetic certified food colour known as Fast Green FCF and declared under different names or numbering systems depending on the market.
why_botia: BOTIA flags Fast Green FCF because less than 5% is absorbed from the intestine, so almost all of it passes through the body without entering the bloodstream. It is not authorised as a food additive in the European Union, so finding it on a label intended for another market is an important regulatory difference. JECFA established an acceptable daily intake and concluded that estimated dietary exposure does not present a health concern. In the United States, many food companies and industry groups have committed to removing petroleum-based synthetic food dyes. This is a voluntary industry transition, not a ban.
